headline: GIFT Nifty signals soft start while Indian markets rally on foreign fund inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Jefferies named top buy ideas including ICICI Bank, RIL, and SBI as India defies a 20-year earnings trend.
Foreign fund inflows and buying in IT stocks supported recent strong market rallies.
GIFT Nifty signaled a negative opening for Indian benchmark indices on November 27.
Brent crude oil prices traded near a month's high due to Middle East conflict threatening supply.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty rallied over recent trading sessions driven by FII inflows and IT stock gains.
GIFT Nifty pointed to a cautious open for Indian stock markets on Friday morning.
Jefferies highlighted 10 stock recommendations for Indian equity investors.
Stocks to watch for the trading session include Waaree Renewable and KPI Green.
summary: Indian benchmark indices recently surged on foreign fund buying and strength in IT equities. GIFT Nifty indicates a potentially negative opening on November 27 amid global cues. Top brokerage recommendations from Jefferies include ICICI Bank, Reliance, and SBI.
